Chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B. Start at fci: the pair (fci, dhh) comes first; its second item is dhh, so the next pair is the one whose first item is dhh: (dhh, ddd). Its second item is ddd, but ddd never appears as a first item - so ddd is the dangling end of the chain.
